coverage_assessment: Broad open-web first pass: 43 captured searches / 611 result headers across Portuguese, English and attempted Kriolu variants, date windows, islands/major cities, regional outlets, and labor, education, student, health, transport, price, utility, justice, and resident sectors. Two January leads remain pending evidence; all 14 cards are search_only and no article body was read. S008 had one web-tool timeout and one ordinary HTTPS DNS failure before HTTP; no denial was observed and, per coordinator instruction, it was not retried. Regional/language coverage is uneven; no systematic Kriolu corpus or LexisNexis-equivalent archive was available. The post-month teacher-action lead is separately recorded; no protest absence is inferred.
